webauthn.title: Security keys and passkeys
webauthn.help: A security key (e.g. YubiKey) or the authenticator of your device (Windows Hello, Touch ID, Android) as additional factor.
webauthn.name: Name
webauthn.name_help: So you recognise it later, e.g. “YubiKey blue” or “Laptop”.
webauthn.remove_confirm: Remove “{name}”? It can no longer be used to sign in.
webauthn.unsupported: This browser does not support security keys.
webauthn.cancelled: The security key was not used (cancelled or timed out).
webauthn.reauth: For your security: please sign out and in again, then add or remove keys within 15 minutes.
webauthn.as_passkey_help: Stored on the key or device; signs in without password where the administration allows it.
webauthn.help_first: With a passkey you sign in without password: your device or security key confirms it is you (PIN, fingerprint, face).
